data.name: Laraibah
data.gender_notes: Laraibah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who Carries Radiant Light. The name Laraibah carries the meaning “Radiant Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Laraibah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and guidance, illuminating the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Laraibah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laraibah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: لارائب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم لارائب مشتق من الجذر العربي لا ر أ ب، الذي يعني الجمال والرقة، وله تاريخ عريق في التراث الإسلامي والثقافة العربية، حيث يرمز إلى الأنوثة واللطافة والجمال الخلّاق

in_urdu.name: لارائب
in_urdu.long_meaning: لارائب کا نام عربی جڑ لا ر أ ب سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خوبصورتی اور نازک خیال کا معنی دیتا ہے، اور اس کا اسلامی روایت اور ثقافت میں گہرا اثر ہے، جہاں یہ عورتوں کی خوبصورتی اور لطافت کی象征 ہے

in_hindi.name: लारائب
in_hindi.long_meaning: लारائب नाम अरबी मूल لا र أ ب से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ सुंदरता और नाजुकता है, और इसका इस्लामी परंपरा और संस्कृति में गहरा प्रभाव है, जहां यह स्त्रियों की सुंदरता और कोमलता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: لارائب
in_pashto.long_meaning: لارائب نوم د عربي ریښ لا ر أ ب څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د ښکلا او نازکتیا په معنی دی، او دا د افغان/پښتون دود او اسلامي文化 کې د ښځو د ښکلا او لږتیا د象征 په توګه重要 دی

in_english.name: Laraibah
in_english.long_meaning: Laraibah is derived from the Arabic root la ra b, meaning beauty and delicacy, and holds significant cultural and historical importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing femininity, gentleness, and beauty, with roots in Quranic and Arabic etymology

data.cultural_impact: The name Laraibah signifies the concept of personifying light, an idea that holds great significance in Islamic culture. The holy text, the Quran, contains numerous verses that speak about Allah (God) being the light of the heavens and earth, and guiding His creation through illumination. Laraibah can be seen as embodying this concept, being a shining example of awareness, knowledge, and moralGuidance in the darkness of life.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Laraibah can be interpreted as a reminder of the light within each individual soul. It is a call to seek knowledge, illumination, and enlightenment from Allah. By carrying the name Laraibah, one is encouraged to strive for a radiant, noble and virtuous character. It is a reminder to mirror the trait of carrying light, a metaphor for carrying kindness, wisdom, and guidance, thereby spreading positivity and love in the world. Ultimately, by honoring this name, one aspires to obtain Allah's pleasure, eternal happiness, and eternal success.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant Light" symbolizes The One Who Carries Radiant Light. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Laraibah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant light.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Laraibah is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad.
historical_references.context: The name is associated with the Islamic Golden Age and the Abbasid Caliphate.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and North Africa
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Laraibah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Aisha Laraibah in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Laraibah, which means "Radiant Light". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
